reviews.text: Best hummingbird feeder. I love how the app lets you share with family and keep a collection of the birds you get. I love how it saves videos and lets you name the birds.

Money grab now. I used to love my Bird Buddy, it was fun and I loved seeing the various visitors. But after a few updates many standard features (such as auto identifying) are now blocked and hidden behind costly subscriptions. We used to be able to ignore certain visitors but now you can’t do that unless you pay an exorbitant subscription after already paying a ton for the feeder itself. I didn’t mind the premium on the feeder since the built in features were worth it, but now those features cost extra and the feeder still costs the same… you can’t have it both ways, if you want us to buy into the subscription then the feeder should be half the cost it is now, otherwise go back to providing the same features you used to. I would not recommend anyone buying a Bird Buddy now, I’d say to look at the much cheaper alternatives.

Almost great. I do really like the app, there’s room for improvement for sure. Sometimes the identification is off or wrong, other times I can see birds at the feeder and never get a notification or a postcard. The postcards are not the best either most of them are blurry or the back of birds. I also thing that the app itself has some odd features like the editing of postcards to add hats and scarves lol it’s just not for me. Overall the app works but it’s not as user friendly as I think it could be.

BB got greedy. I loved my BirdBuddy in the beginning, however, core features such as automatic bird ID are now behind a paywall. After paying $200+ for a bird feeder, I have no interest in paying extra for a subscription. I used to love getting notifications letting me know who was at the feeder. Now I just get generic notifications with additional steps to see which species are there. I rarely even check the app anymore. The downgrade in features previously offered is extremely disappointing.

No longer identifies automatically?!. We just set up our Birdbuddy and were enjoying the automatic bird identification. Now apparently it is behind a pay wall? We bought it specifically for that feature and it is rotten when a company takes away something that was a selling point to begin with.
Penis. Why do the birds not have pen is?
Bird buddy. Loving my bird Buddy. Love how it identifies the birds !

Additional content needs UX improvements. App is crashing when I browse the Collections list of birds, specifically when I am in the E’s. It would be helpful to be able to jump to the different letters rather than having to scroll all the way through the alphabet to browse a specific letter.

Best Mother’s Day present ever. This bird feeder given me lots of joy. I love that I have this new job of taking care of their feeder. I did find I had to add a few accessories to make it work better for my visitors. I got a ledge extender, I bought a baffle to keep the squirrels away, and the seed catcher to keep the messy birds from spread, spreading the seed all over my lawn! Thinking of saving up for the hummingbird version.

I love the feeder. I love the feeder. It doesn’t always notify when I have a bird and the same bird came more than once yesterday and it identified it as 2 different birds. I also get a few that can not be recognized… even so some of them have already visited.

A wonderful hobby. UPDATED REVIEW 6/30/26:
I love my Birdbuddy. It has awakened an interest in birdwatching that I've never suspected I would enjoy so much. The camera takes gorgeous photos, and is very reliable. I had another brand of camera feeder before, and it was very frustrating because livestream rarely worked, and it would take a video even if a leaf or shadow moved near it. BirdBuddy is the best.

I do hope the developers will continue to improve the app. Overall, it works very well - but several features are urgently needed. 

I would ask for two features to be added as soon as possible: 1) I urgently need to be able to delete the two bird nicknames I created. I'm not enjoying that as much as I thought I would, and there is no way to either edit/change or delete those nicknames. 2) I very much like to keep my collected videos sorted and labeled properly, but sometimes I make mistakes, and there is no way to edit the species classification either I or the Birdbuddy app assigned to the photo/video before I saved it. 

Please, please add these capabilities soon.
Hummingbird feeder. This has to be one of the best gifts I’ve ever received.
Wonderful Technology. Buy a bird feeder, nature will heal your soul

Too much locked behind sub. I can’t invite my other family members in the house to connect to the camera without having to pay a subscription free. That’s insane. This is not a cheap device and I expect at least to have my wife also be able to use it. Greedy.
Hummingbird feeder. This was the best gift ever! The joy of getting to see hummingbirds that I might have missed otherwise is wonderful. 😊

Won’t connect to app. Bought this as a gift. I have tried so many times to complete setup. I have used home wifi and my hotspot. I can connect the device to my home internet and hotspot, but the connection to the bird buddy account always fails. Ready to give up because I haven’t heard back from support.

What a waste. $200 for a plastic hummingbird feeder and they’ve still managed to paywall half the useful features for it. Never mind the fact the livestream takes forever to connect with strong signal and the bird “identification” struggles to identify the one kind of bird that shows up. I was super excited to share the livestream with my girlfriend since we’re long distance but that’s an extra tier of monthly membership! Greed knows no limits, buy ANY other product if you’re reading this please

A birdwatching must!. Birdbuddy is absolutely fantastic! It is a must for bird watchers. We now know the species and numbers of birds in our yard. It is educational too through its AI integration. The only issue is they the user interface is very crowded and seemingly unorganized. If the UI were better and cleaner, it would by 5 stars.
First thoughts. A little confusing but fun to see all the birds

Too expensive. So I have to pay $90 per year, just so my family can stream a video from my feeder? As a dev, I could build my own crappier one for less money, but I’d never have to pay any fee ever. The app is nice at least.

Not a smart feeder. I am very disappointed in my birdbuddy Hummingbird feeder. I have had it up for nearly 2 months and it has captured a total of 2 postcards. I thought this out of character for a hummingbird, which tend to have excellent memories and follow the same nectar routes so I put up an external birdfy camera to see if I was getting more visits: I'm capturing between 10-30 visits per day on the birdfy camera. In just 10 days since | put up the external camera I have captured 169 visits that were all missed by the bird buddy. I would NOT recommend paying $200 for this smart feeder plus $100 for the Al identification that is really just a normal hummingbird feeder with a fake camera installed. I contacted customer support and their response was basically
"it's working just fine." Save your money and just buy a normal hummingbird feeder without a camera, you'll likely get the same number of pictures.

Awesome digital camera!!. Anyone who enjoys watching birds should have one of these Birdbuddy feeders! I prefer watching the gorgeous hummingbirds but the regular birdseed feeders are just as much fun for the entire family!! My family and friends really enjoy them just as much as I do when I share the videos with them. You will all LOVE watching the birds!

Amazing when first released, not worth the money now. I loved my bird buddy when I first got it. I got it through one of the original kickstarter campaigns, or whichever platform they used. The bird ID was spot on, I rarely had to correct it. Then it started to not be able to recognize birds that have visited my feeder 100’s of times (Blue Jays, Northern Cardinals). Then it started to not even record bird visits. I would see a cool interaction at the feeder through my window, but that event would never show up in my postcards. Now they’ve taken away the bird ID feature unless you pay for premium. Mine is getting close to needing to be replaced - I’m looking into other ‘copycat’ brands because Birdbuddy seems to have just become a name brand where you pay for the name but the product just isn’t worth the money anymore unfortunately.

Obnoxious Notification System. I like this app in concept and I like checking on the birds but there is no way to stop the constant notifications without turning them off all together. I’m getting 20 notifications an hour about the same house finches, even with the Smart notifications toggled on which are supposed to help.

AI has made this a low-quality product. automatic bird ID has been paywalls and has lost basic functionality. ID is also less accurate, their old algorithm worked better than AI, but doesn’t give you the option to - it’s force-feeding lower-quality functionality. take the loss on the AI investment, because it has broken the product.

Not pairing, no support.. Spent the extra $100 to get one of these and can’t get it to pair right off the bat. $200 feeder that doesn’t function. Support is AI slop bot. Save your money!!

Hitting “contact support” button does nothing, nor does troubleshoot. Uninstall app, re install app 3x… 

Tweaked my router. Created a 2.4GHZ network just for Birdbuddy. Reset it. Restarted phone. 
Before you buy this product do some research. For example, THERE IS NO CUSTOMER SERVICE NUMBER. Fortunately, I bought unit from chewy and not direct, with chewy I was able to talk to customer service and get a refund in less than 10 minutes.

Slow and over featured. I just want to watch birds on my camera that I paid for, not be solicited for a subscription every time I open the app or have to ‘livestream’ to turn the camera on, or deal with any ai BS, or miss the birds because it takes 10 minutes every time the camera wakes up, or get notifications, just stop with all this and let me use the camera to watch birds, record video and take pictures.
Patience!. I was beginning to get very disappointed because there were no hummingbirds coming to our feeders. It took a couple of weeks, but suddenly boom they are here.
Hard to set up. Problems

Great way to learn the different birds in my area. I began wfh and realized how much I enjoyed seeing the birds outside my window. For Christmas my boyfriend bought me a Bird Buddy and I have loved having it and capturing video and photos of the various birds that visit my feeder. It was easy to set up and to connect to my WiFi, and is providing plenty of awesome and enjoyment!

Doesn’t do what it used to. Birdbuddy used to automatically attempt to identify birds. You could choose to hide certain birds. I hid blue jays, but the update no longer identifies visitors. Now I receive multiple blue Jay postcards hourly. It’s ridiculous. I’m adding something my husband printed to try to keep large birds out in hopes of just getting postcards of other visitors.
Mixed. The camera is great! The app keeps telling me a non rare bird is a “new species” daily.
Pros and cons. Still love the pics

Birdbuddy. I love watching hummingbirds. I received this as a gift and I love it. I wish I had more birds using it but maybe in time. Best gift to enjoy watching the birds and the picture is clear and you can zoom in and really get a close up. I absolutely love my Birdbuddy.

Get a Birdbuddy!!!. I got the Birdbuddy Pro Solar for my grandfather for his small backyard. He loves it! He’s always loved watching them and having them even closer, all of it is in 2k quality and I can’t say it enough but it’s so cool learning about the birds in your own backyard!

Degraded service. This company has removed nearly all functions available at launch and put them behind a paywall. It is now just a camera. Save your money and get a better product. To maximize short term profits they have degraded the service. This is terrible for a product that started on Kickstarter.

Disappointed with updates. I enjoyed my feeder all last summer but this year I find that I can no longer ignore the dozens and dozens of sparrows that show up every day. The “Ignore species “ has been moved to the premium version only so I have had to turn off notifications and photo capture all together. My feeder is now just a box with bird seed in it. Bad move.
Great App But …. I would love to give this 5 stars because we love everything about it except the live stream does not include audio! Bummer.

Love it!. The Birdbuddy is a great start for me and my family. Though it was a bit tricky to start birds started to pop up like crazy! The Birdbuddy is my new favorite bird watching app for sounds and photos.
Hummingbird BirdBuddy. Trouble accessing my saved views on app

Better before they added AI. When I first got my Bird Buddy, it would give me a decent guess as to what the bird was, which helped me with identifying birds in general. The videos were also clips that included animals. Now every bird is listed as ‘unidentified’ (unless you pay regularly for AI) and videos will often have 10-30 seconds of the bird and 30 seconds of just the background

Quality has gone down. The products they release are not tested and rushed to generate cash. The app releases are not tested and always buggy. They are moving fundamental features into a paid model outside of the standard ones they originally sold it as.
Love this product. It is so cool to see the birds that are caught on camera. Have had some squirrels too. Makes me feel good to know I am helping the wildlife!

Good feeder, app, etc, but restrictive. Love almost everything about Birdbuddy but ui is restive and doesn’t allow for easy picture collecting within the app, I suggest just downloading photos you want to photo library and making collections there

AVOID AT ALL COSTS. This has to be one of the most predatory apps I have ever seen. Firstly, when signing up and connecting, I get hit with a page that wants me to spend money on an annual subscription plan. Wasn't planning on paying it cause everything said that you can still use the feeder while not having a subscription. Here is the first problem, THERE IS NO 'X' TO LEAVE THIS PAGE!!!! This is a textbook predatory tactic to make people feel like the only way forward is to pay for a subscription. The only way to get around it is to completely close the app and go back into it. Though, that is not all. I get a prompt that tells me to share access to the feeder with family and friend. I do so, but I HAVE TO PAY FOR THE SUBSCRIPTION TO LET THEM JOIN!!!! Another textbook predatory tactice where people will feel bad and pressured to buy a sunscription since they already sent a message to family, yet they can't actually view the feed. The dumbest thing is that they can see the feeder exists on the app, yet they can't watch any live feed. 4.8 stars is also hard to get on the app store, especially with predatory subscriptions like this? Probably targeting only users who have had a positive experience with the app. Please do not buy or gift any of this company's products for anyone
Membership change. I hate that they changed the membership. Now feels like another greedy company.

Not worth the money. This bird camera is expensive, and many times it doesn’t capture the video of my hummingbird. I watched a bird on my feeder for over a minute, and the camera did not capture it. Plus you have to pay extra for any additional features they offer in a monthly subscription. The video quality when it does capture a bird is very good. But frustrating that it doesn’t always capture a visit.

Choose another birding app. This app and its platform is more frustration than it is fun. I’ve had a Birdbuddy feeder and the app for a few weeks and while it was engaging at first, the sheer volume and frequency of issues has quickly turned it into uselessness. 
The camera simply will not stay connected to the internet. It won’t identify birds and turn on (record) till they’ve been at the feeder for 5-10 seconds, which means it never gets those quick birds that dart in and out (I.e. the good ones you want to see). My “feed” is full of the same bully birds over and over and over again, yet it CONSTANTLY misses the woodpeckers and chickadees that visit the feeder.
The best thing I can do with it is go into the live feed and manually take pictures of the birds that visit, but this is also an exercise in frustration. First, it takes 5 minutes to get the live feed working (have to make 5-10 attempts, shutting down the app over and over again to get it to work). Then, when you see a bird, you snap a bunch of pictures and send those off for identification. Ah, but it caps the number of pics you can take at 12, and once you’ve met the limit, you can’t simply save the pics and ID later. You have to send those off for identification, and of COURSE it kicks you off the live stream every time you do this. So every time you take a series of pics on the live stream, you have to spend another 5 minutes to log back into the livestream.
Save yourself the hassle…try another brand, or save yourself some money and just go with a regular bird feeder.

Ridiculous. The charging cord came apart. The camera won’t charge. Have no one from the company to assist. Am totally frustrated. This was a gift from my children and I am so disappointed in this. Will end up using it as a bird feeder because nothing works. Solar roof is a joke does not charge the camera. I am so upset and disappointed with this product.

Now you have to pay. The previous version of the app is what made the bird buddy exciting to use. Now they want you to pay. I agree with another review that stated this is now a bird feeder with a camera. Once my bird food runs out I’m done with this product
Great Videos. The Birdbuddy is easy to use and videos are very clear. Really enjoying seeing our backyard visitors!

The notifications need a fix. It’s all or one and I find myself constantly pausing the notifications because otherwise they are nonstop and distracting. There need to be a new notification option developed for those that want something in between

Now it’s a bird feeder. I was so happy with my bird buddy for several years! I received it as a gift and bought one as a gift for someone else. However with the latest app update, one of the core functions has been converted to paid subscription. Now it is merely a bird feeder with a camera - it doesn’t even record every bird visitor. Not sure how this change got approval, but it has definitely ticked off a lot of loyal customers (check out Reddit on the topic) So disappointing!

I’ve owned Bird Buddy for two years, and the new update is a straight-up bait-and-switch.. I paid a premium price for the hardware, and now they’re trying to force a $100/year subscription just to access features that were originally included.
This wasn’t the deal when I bought it.This wasn’t advertised.And it’s not acceptable to lock existing customers out of their own device unless they pay again.The feeder itself is great, but the business model has turned into pure greed.
If you’re thinking about buying one, understand that the company can (and apparently will) take away features you already paid for and shove them behind a subscription later.

I can’t recommend this product anymore until they respect the people who supported them from the beginning.

Birdbuddy is the best !!!!!. I received Birdbuddy for Mother’s Day this year , and absolutely love it !!!! My Daughter has one also, so we check in on each other’s birds often. Excellent gift for anyone who loves to watch birds !!!!!!
Removed features. The automated identification feature was removed from the free subscription to paid subscription.

Buyer beware. while this is a fun app, the most annoying feature is that you can only pause notifications up to a week. every day you are constantly subjected to notifications I’ve gotten 64 notifications in one day. And there is no way to stop them and just go back to the app when you feel like looking at the birds. You’re only option is to pause them for up to one week and then they are back. You can have smart notifications on and that’s what I have and I got 34 notifications in one morning or you have to have notifications on constantly. This is super annoying.

Disappointing. Was very excited to receive this as a gift but it has been nothing but frustrating from the start. First of all, my kids didn’t know a paid subscription is required for most of the selling features. I have the 7 day free trial but at this rate I won’t be able to determine if it’s worth the cost as I can rarely connect to the unit. My wifi strength is strong and I keep moving the unit closer & closer to my home but the livestream fails. Question is why would you create an app that only really works on 2.4G internet when most services/providers are getting stronger (we have 5G)? Seems counterintuitive. Support is useless as the bot just keeps referring me back to the same steps over and over… Additionally, I’m not thrilled that I won’t be able to completely delete my info if I want to give the feeder to someone else. Why would I need anything stored in perpetuity if it was unsuccessful at best? I’ll keep trying but this is taking the fun out of birdwatching.
Squirrel Naming. I would like to name squirrels pls
So good. This is a very nice app, I recommend it

Why would you mess up a good experience?. So, you took away a feature that was standard. Who does that? Why would you do that to your customers? Having to click a button to identify every bird is not an improved experience. That stinks. And here I have just bought another Birdbuddy as a gift for someone else. Questioning my life choices at the moment.

Not worth opening the app anymore. Ridiculous that this company would take away the most important feature for this app (AI bird identification) and start requiring a subscription to identify birds that stop by. I already paid $200+ for this product and now it’s useless for its original purpose!!! I might as well get a baby monitor cam and tape it onto bowl of bird food.. I get way too many cardinals and I want to ignore them but because the app won’t identify them ahead of time, I get stupid notifications for every bird even though I don’t want to see them! Bait and switch by this company this product had major potential but the company just wants to drain their customers wallets with this subscription model.

Loved the app a year ago, many features now paywalled. Will not be purchasing more feeders. Got my first bird buddy over a year ago and instantly loved it. Encountered a couple small bugs here and there but nothing bothersome. Liked a lot of the features of the free tier , especially the app ID’ing birds and sending you a notification of what birds were stopping by. This feature has now been moved to the premium tier. The app is also constantly adding AI features that, from a user standpoint, seem unneeded and don’t improve anything. Admittedly not an app-breaking problem but I don’t think this type of conduct should be rewarded. I would not have purchased a hummingbird video feeder from Birdbuddy had I known this would happen. From the recent reviews, I gather many others feel similarly.

Garbage Update. Zero birds get ID’ed now. The switched their ID to AI and did it on the cheap. To save costs, now you have to manually prompt it to ID birds instead of it being done automatically. I would return this birdhouse if I could.

Used to be great, but they’ve now hidden greatness behind a paywall. So disappointed, so mad. After paying hundreds for the bird feeder the app no longer fulfills its promise - to identify birds by photo and sound - unless you pay more. The bird identification worked great. The bird identification AI worked great for us. We had a symbiotic relationship. By using the app, we the consumers, feed you data that improves your AI. But now, you’re simply taking out data and charging us for it. I guess I’m simply going to have to use Merlin to ID birds now.
Squirrel deterrence. Maybe someone with the experience could right a program to install in the camera to scare away squirrels. Sounds, lights whatever! Good idea right?!
Very amazing videos. We just got our first hummingbird & the video is amazing. Love it so much we’re going to buy a second one.
Does Not Work. App is extremely slow and will not allow us to log in.

New Birdbuddy2 is great.. App notifications and video/pics work well. Species identification is strong. The app is also useful to track the charge (solar panels are suggested) and generally easy to use. It is mysterious why folks balk at a small fee- the AI is a valuable feature and I’d like the company to stay around !

Junky UI/UX. way too many popups and upsells, some which are impossible to dismiss (premium upsell has no X button! Wth?). Got this for my parents and all they need is the livestream. Lose the junk and it would be much better.
Love it!!!. So wonderful to appreciate nature with a front seat view.

ruined by AI upgrade. This was such a great app/feeder system last year! Sadly, they decided to upgrade to “a more advanced AI model,” and now it barely functions. Mine will only take pictures of one kind of bird (the AI is using its judgement to decide what I see, and it only judges northern cardinals as worthy), and the app offers way less information about birds than it used to. I really wish the app that worked was still an option, instead of the AI-driven crummy Instagram for birds they’ve decided to be.

Getting worse. I received a Bird Buddy feeder as a gift a couple of years ago. At first, I was very pleased with the app interface. Remember that this a very expensive product to begin with. It used to automatically identify the birds in the videos it produced. You have to now tap an option on each video to ID the birds. When you send videos to others, it used to provide the species names, but no longer does. Previously, you had the option to exclude birds that appear too often in the feed. For example, I don’t need 15 videos of Northern Cardinals every day. You can choose to exclude species but it no longer works, I guess because it doesn’t ID in real time as previously. Be forewarned that the app constantly offers you very cool options. You then find out that these options require a subscription. What I find absurd is that they use Kickstarter to fund new products. This is now an established company. It seems tacky to fund in this manner. Kickstarter should be for actual startups.
App used to be great. They put a lot of regular features that used to be included behind a paywall like bird ids. That’s the whole point of the app.

Best gift ever. My beautiful friend gifted me this last year, I am so grateful for this and the images it brings every day showing us the preciousness in every creature and admiring the divinity of each creation. Forever grateful to my wonderful friend, Cindy and to you for giving us this experience with the bird buddy authenticity!!!
Fun to watch the sweet birds!. I’m absolutely loving my Birdbuddy! It’s so fun to see those sweet little birds enjoying their food and watching them interact with each other!

Love the app but horrible customer service. I’ve been trying to reach customer service as I was charged twice (PayPal acct and credit card) for the annual membership. No contact number so I’ve been on website chat which doesn’t give you a person but says they will have someone contact you (no one has contacted me). I’ve emailed three or four times. No one replies back. HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE AND CHARGES TWICE!!!
Remove features after purchase. I have 3 of these feeders - a first day backer. They removed the bird identification which was the core selling point.

Bait and switch. I bought my unit back when it identified birds. They now make you pay for identification. This is so wrong, I paid for the ID feature when it was included and now I have pay extra for it.

Time. I spend more time correcting birds and labeling them than I did before. Some birds are very obvious but it stated unidentified. 

I have a lot of birds that are in the not identified folder but they have been identified and I try to group them to correct bit I have to one by one so I give up.

Removing Festures. The app used to automatically identify all your visitors, but recently they changed it so that you have to click on each bird tag to identify it. They are pushing users towards their paid services by removing features that were previously included. I would beware of what they remove next. I certainly won’t recommend it to friends and family anymore.

No more bird identification. The app used to automatically identify the birds that would come to the feeder. Now you have to go through the hundreds of daily “post cards” and tap the analyze button and cross your fingers for a result. Why downgrade the app??? Makes zero sense.

Disappointed. I was so very excited about this. I’ve always been a huge fan of birds and bird watching so I finally took the plunge and bought this for myself. 

Although I love the solar panel function and the video and photos are clear, I’m very disappointed that it misses more birds than it captures, and the fact that it only alerts me after it’s taken a “postcard” not when a bird actually arrives. I would much rather have instant notifications and the ability to connect to the livestream to watch the birds in real time instead of after the fact. I got a camera so I could get to see birds that might visit and I miss because I’m not watching my feeder, and here I am seeing more birds watching the feeder myself than with the camera watching. If I had known this about Bird Buddy I would not have purchased.

Taking away features. Very frustrated that automatic bird ID was put behind a paywall. This was advertised as something included with my feeder, and now you are making people pay for it. The accuracy of the bird ID was so bad most of the time, so it’s not something I’m willing to pay for.

Bad Product Update. Came here to see how badly this app is getting savaged for putting what once was core functionality behind a subscription model. I’m not at all surprised to see that they rightfully have been taken to task for what can only be described as a serious blunder. 

I totally understand the need to generate consistent revenue, but thinking you can drum it out of your existing user base by taking away features you previously gave them seamlessly for free and cowardly framing it as an product improvement is crazy bold and borderline gaslighting! You have seriously burnt up a ton of goodwill and the fact that you can’t figure out how to make a truly compelling subscription with *new* features makes me question the long term viability of your service. I hope these reviews are making up to the leaders at BB and that they figure out a way to backtrack out of this mess soon!

What is even happening?. I backed both bird buddy and bird buddy 2 and we waited a long time to get these feeders. I’ve stayed loyal to bird buddy even with there being tons of cheaper options these days. We spent years training the ai model and now so many app features are being moved or hidden or put behind a paywall. Idk man. Y’all need to think back on how this all started. This is already a luxury item (in this economy)… and I just feel kind of betrayed. Especially after JUST getting the bird buddy 2.
Paywall. They put the main selling point of the app - automatic bird ID - behind a paywall. False advetising and greedy corporate practices. Buy anything else.
Bird ID is a core feature. Locking it behind a paywall add and making me click the button every time is really shady for a product we’ve already purchased. I’d consider alternatives
New paywall. Please unlock the autoID.

Greedy and Disappointing. The new update is horrible. All the best features - like bird ID - are now hidden behind a paywall. I already bought a $250 birdfeeder - now I have to shell out even more just to use the features it originally came with. Absolute money grab and these guys should be ashamed of themselves.

Degrading in front of our eyes. I’d probably aim for different smart feeders. BirdBuddy seems bent on progressively stripping features from the free version. 

At this point there’s no ID and no ability to control which species are photographed (or ignored). I’m sure by the end of the year they’ll restrict non-subscribed users to like 2 photos per day. .
it was good, then the paywall. it was a pretty good app, but paywalling essential features like automatic bird ID after a bunch of people bought it when it was free is complete BS!!!

Disappointed with update. I can no longer recommend BirdBuddy. A recent update has made it so Bird Buddy will no longer automatically identify birds, or ignore unwanted species, without paying for the premium service on top of an already expensive feeder. Something that used to be so basic as IDing birds shouldn’t be taken away. I probably wouldn’t purchase today knowing this is the direction the app is headed.

Great until it wasn’t. Automatic ID was the sore purpose of this product and now it’s placed behind a paywall even though I’ve already purchased the item. Save yourself the money and don’t buy this product.

Doesn’t Recognize Common Birds Anymore. I used to like this app but for the last month it doesn’t recognize a single one of my frequent birds anymore. I’m not sure what changed but it is kind of worthless to me now. I think they are just trying to sell a premium subscription package.

Self Inflicted AI Rot. Bird Buddy choosing to remove the absolute most basic feature and selling point, in bird identification, from a device we all own to try to recoup money on a incredibly useless from the beginning FOMO-induced “AI” integration and investment (which from then on messed up identification constantly on clear as day photos that the original machine learning model had no issue with) is as desperate a decision as I’ve seen in a long time. Not necessarily desperate for revenue but an executive or several desperate to hang on to their gullible convictions in a coming AI first economy. They’ve steadily made the product worse since I’ve owned it and paywalling the core function that has always been available is not only dumb, shortsighted strategy but incredibly insulting. No one should pay for any service from this company while vampirism is the corporate strategy. Frankly, peak Kickstarter business behavior.

Bird Buddy added a feature a while ago where you can connect your app to three random bird feeders around the world to see what kind of birds visit feeders in Costa Rica or Belgium or other places.

I wasn’t interested in it because I just want to see the birds that visit my feeders and the ones of my friends and family. Lo and behold, they recently changed that feature to be less obtrusive if it doesn’t interest you.

At the same time, they have made it easier to view a live feed of your own feeder. It is, unfortunately, still a bit slow to load. They warn it can take something like 30 seconds to load the live view, so if you’re pulling it up because you just spotted a bird at your feeder, you’ll probably miss it (at least, I usually do).

As for the physical product, the camera is fine, and the battery life is okay. I charge mine a couple times a month, and the camera auto-adjusts its exposure for the whole image rather than optimizing for the darker objects, which tend to be the birds.

Altogether, it’s good enough to do what it’s designed to do: Take videos and photos of birds that visit your bird feeder, which fundamentally is a great value proposition.

There is an up-sell currently priced at $60 per year or $6 per month. You unlock higher-resolution video, a more sensitive motion detection system (so you catch more flighty birds), the ability to ignore squirrels or bird species that don’t interest you, and the ability to share your bird feeder feed with up to 10 people (instead of 3).
Props for the free updates. Updating my review to reflect the fact that the most important paywalled feature (ignoring species) is now free. Thanks for listening to feedback!
